title: AI contract review: what it catches and how to test it
description: How AI reviews contracts for clauses, risks and obligations, which public benchmarks exist, and how to test it on your own contracts.
summary: AI contract review reads an agreement, finds the clauses that matter, and flags terms that differ from your standard. It speeds up first review; a lawyer still signs off.

example.input: A 40-page supplier agreement and your company's standard positions.
example.output: Every clause that departs from your standard, with the page, the risk in one line, and a suggested redline.

howToTest: Pick 20 past contracts your lawyers already reviewed, with their marked-up issues.
Run each model and count how many of the lawyers' issues it finds, and how many false alarms it raises.
Check that every flag points to the exact clause and page.
Compare cost and time per contract.

buyVsBuild.buy: Buy a legal AI product when your contracts are common types and you want lawyers using it this month.
buyVsBuild.build: Build when your playbook is specific and you review high volumes of one contract type.

watchOuts: Missed issues cost more than false alarms; count both.
Long contracts can exceed what a model reads reliably in one pass.
Results on public legal tests may not match your contract types.
